outreach_draft.subject: A thought on your Estate Planning / Probate page
outreach_draft.body:
Hi Lorie,

I was reviewing the current Cevallos Law Firm site and noticed that Family Law, Immigration, removal/federal litigation, and estate-related services such as wills and probate all share one general Practice Areas page. Those clients arrive with very different goals and questions, so they are currently entering the same broad website conversation.

A focused Estate Planning / Probate page could give those clients a clearer explanation of the matters you handle, who the service is for, and the next step to take. It would also create a more focused service context for Google and make the firm’s offering easier for AI systems to understand when someone is specifically looking for wills or probate help.

Estate Planning / Probate seems like a useful first mockup because the service is explicitly offered today but has no dedicated destination.

I’m putting together a quick mockup to show you what I mean. I’ll send it over in the next couple of days.

If you’d rather I didn’t, just let me know.
